name: Lindus Health (now trading as Lindus Therapeutics)
what: Began as a tech-enabled 'anti-CRO' running clinical trials on its Citrus platform; in Aug 2026 it sold its CRO assets to Curavit and now in-licenses and develops drug assets as Lindus Therapeutics.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); the company's own release names Visionaries Club in the Jan 2025 Series B.
membership.quote: led by new investor Balderton Capital , with support from Visionaries Club

entry.quote: announced today it has raised $55M in Series B funding

funding_rounds.round: Seed / early rounds (about $6M before the Series A)

status.event: Sold its CRO assets to Curavit Clinical Research (Boston) and continues as Lindus Therapeutics, in-licensing drug assets; the company itself was not sold

valuation.quote: No priced valuation published for the Series A or Series B.

notes: Entry: Visionaries is named apart from the 'existing investors' (Creandum, Firstminute, Seedcamp) in the Series B release, so the Series B is its first round; TechCrunch (2025-01-22) and Balderton's post (2025-01-22) name it the same way. SURPRISE: lindushealth.com now redirects to lindustx.com ('Lindus Therapeutics'); the buyer's release (Curavit Clinical Research, PR Newswire 2026-08-18) announces 'the acquisition of the CRO assets of Lindus Health', following 'Lindus shifting focus to developing its own pipeline of therapeutic assets, as Lindus Therapeutics'; Endpoints headlined it 'Thiel-backed Lindus sells CRO arm in pivot to hunt for drug assets' (2026-09-04, paywalled). Terms not disclosed. Found via googlenews '"Lindus" CRO after:2026-06-01'. The legal entity is unchanged (Lindus Health Limited, registered office 65 Southwark Street, London, per the privacy policy), so status stays private; the judge may want to note the business change. HQ: TechCrunch (2025-01-22) said a move of global HQ from the UK to the US was 'currently underway', but the current site still gives only the London registered office, so London kept (agrees with Balderton and Creandum siblings). Focus stays Healthcare & Bio either way. Vehicle hint inferred (Series B, 2025 -> Growth Fund II), low confidence.
